fix: Load the JWT secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the exposed value.
Use a parameterized query such as `WHERE title LIKE $1` with `['%' + q + '%']`.
Reduce the name with path.basename (or resolve and verify it stays inside REPORT_DIR) before calling sendFile.
Hash passwords with a salted slow algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of schemes and hosts and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Add requireAdmin or check that the ticket belongs to req.user before deleting.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate `format` against an allow-list such as csv/json.
